en.title: Privacy Policy
en.description: How Screenshots to Video handles accounts, screenshots, drafts and generation results.
sections: Accounts and purchases
We process your account name, email, authentication details and purchase records to operate the service. Payment is handled by Stripe; our application does not store complete card numbers.
Screenshots and generation

When you submit a video request, we store the screenshots in a private object-storage bucket and send the prompt, settings and limited-time screenshot access links to SeeAPI. SeeAPI and the selected model process the materials to create the video. Do not upload confidential or personal information without the necessary authorization.
Retention and access

Screenshot uploads are no longer accepted for new tasks after 24 hours. Storage lifecycle deletion is configured for the private input bucket; physical deletion may follow the storage provider's lifecycle schedule. A signed input link is valid for one hour. Provider task data and generated files follow SeeAPI's own retention policy; download important results rather than relying on indefinite availability.
Local drafts

Studio stores your screenshot files and settings in this browser's IndexedDB, separately for each signed-in account, for draft recovery. Drafts expire in the application after 24 hours and are removed when next opened or when you use Clear draft. If you no longer open the app, you can remove them through your browser's site-data controls. A pending request key may also be retained locally to avoid duplicate paid requests.
Attribution and analytics

We use authentication cookies and may record sanitized campaign tags and external referrer hosts. Optional attribution stores first-touch information for up to 30 days and session information for up to 30 minutes, subject to the site's consent setting. Missing referrers remain unknown; they are not automatically classified as ChatGPT visits. Do not include personal data in campaign parameters.
Your requests

Use the Contact page to submit an account support request about access, correction, account deletion or removal of uploaded material. We verify ownership before acting. Deletion requests may require coordination with the generation provider and may be subject to necessary payment, security and legal record retention.
Provider policies

Review SeeAPI's privacy and data-handling policies and Stripe's privacy policy before sending material or making a purchase. We do not promise that provider-retained data is deleted when a browser draft or an application record expires.

zh.title: 隐私政策
zh.description: Screenshots to Video 如何处理账户、截图、草稿和生成结果。
sections: 账户与购买
我们处理账户名称、邮箱、认证信息和购买记录，以提供服务。付款由 Stripe 处理，应用不保存完整银行卡号。
截图与生成
提交视频制作请求时，截图保存在私有对象存储桶，提示词、设置和限时截图链接会发送给 SeeAPI，由其和所选模型处理以生成视频。未经必要授权，请勿上传机密内容或个人信息。
保存与访问
截图上传满 24 小时后不能用于创建新任务。私有输入桶配置存储生命周期删除，实际删除可能按存储服务商的生命周期计划执行；签名输入链接有效期为一小时。供应商任务数据和生成文件遵循 SeeAPI 的保存规则，请下载重要作品，不要依赖无限期可用。
本地草稿
工作台按登录账户在本浏览器 IndexedDB 保存截图文件和设置，用于恢复草稿。应用中的草稿有效期为 24 小时，再次打开或点击清除草稿时会移除；如果不再打开应用，可通过浏览器的站点数据设置删除。待确认请求的标识也可能保存在本地，以避免重复创建收费任务。
来源与分析
我们使用认证 Cookie，并可能记录经过清理的推广标记与外部来源主机。可选来源归因按网站同意设置执行，首次来源最长保存 30 天，会话来源最长保存 30 分钟。缺失来源保持未知，不自动认定为 ChatGPT 流量；推广参数中请勿包含个人信息。
你的请求
可通过联系页面提交账户工单，申请访问、更正、删除账户或移除上传素材。处理前需要核对归属。删除可能需要协调生成供应商，并受必要的支付、安全和法定记录保存要求影响。
供应商政策
提交素材或购买前，请阅读 SeeAPI 的隐私和数据处理政策，以及 Stripe 的隐私政策。浏览器草稿或应用记录到期，不代表供应商保留的数据同时删除。

en.title: Terms of Service
en.description: Conditions for paid screenshot video generation and account use.
sections: The service

Screenshots to Video creates short AI-assisted product videos from screenshots. Homepage animations are illustrative previews using a fictional product, not customer work. AI can alter text, interface details and timing; review each result before publishing. We do not guarantee exact pixel preservation, platform approval or marketing performance.
Paid render packs

The listed packs cost USD 9.90 for one render, USD 19.90 for three, and USD 29.90 for five. They are one-time purchases, not subscriptions. Unused render rights have no application expiry. One newly generated successful video uses one render; repeating generation with changed settings is a new request. Re-downloading an existing available result does not use a new render.
Reservations and failures

A task reserves a paid render when accepted. A confirmed generation failure releases that reservation. A timeout or temporary status-query error does not prove failure: keep the task and check it again. Retrying an uncertain submission with the same request key does not purchase or reserve a second render.
Refund requests

Contact support about an incorrect charge or an unused pack. Automatic full-pack refunds are not supported once a render has been used or is reserved; mandatory rights under applicable law are not excluded. A confirmed failed generation returns its render allowance rather than automatically reversing the original pack payment.
Inputs and permitted use

Only upload screenshots and other content you are authorized to process. Do not use the service for unlawful, abusive or rights-infringing material. You remain responsible for rights in third-party screenshots, trademarks and other inputs; buying a render does not license someone else's material. Output use is also subject to applicable provider terms.
Storage and results

Input screenshots become unavailable for new requests after 24 hours and are shared with the provider by time-limited links. Generated download availability depends on the provider; download your completed results. See the Privacy Policy for local drafts and third-party processing.
Accounts and support

Keep your account credentials secure. Do not attempt to bypass payment, access another person's assets or abuse the service. We may restrict abusive use. Contact support through the Contact page for purchase and task questions.

zh.title: 使用条款
zh.description: 付费截图视频制作及账户使用条件。
sections: 服务说明
Screenshots to Video 使用截图制作简短的 AI 辅助产品视频。首页动画使用虚构产品作为呈现示意，不是客户作品。AI 可能改变文字、界面细节和时间安排，发布前请检查结果；我们不保证逐像素保真、平台审核通过或营销效果。
按次购买
方案为 9.90 美元一次、19.90 美元三次、29.90 美元五次，均为一次性购买而非订阅。未使用制作次数在应用中不设到期时间。每段新生成且成功的视频使用一次；修改设置后重新生成属于新请求。重复下载已有且可用的结果不再消耗次数。
预留与失败
任务接受后预留一次付费制作次数，确认生成失败后释放。超时或暂时无法查询不表示任务已失败，请保留原任务并再次查询；使用相同请求标识重试未确认提交，不会再次购买或预留一次制作次数。
退款请求
错误扣费或未使用套餐问题请联系支持。制作次数已使用或正在预留时不支持自动整包退款，但不排除适用法律规定的强制权利。确认生成失败后返还的是制作次数，不会自动退还原套餐款项。
素材与使用
只上传你有权处理的截图或内容，不得用于违法、滥用或侵犯他人权利的材料。第三方截图、商标和输入内容的权利由你负责确认，购买制作次数不会授予他人素材的许可；输出使用还需遵守适用的供应商条款。
保存与下载
截图满 24 小时后不再用于新请求，通过限时链接向供应商提供。下载结果的可用性取决于供应商，请及时下载完成的作品；本地草稿及第三方处理说明见隐私政策。
账户与支持
请保护账户凭证，不得绕过付费、访问他人素材或滥用服务。我们可能限制滥用行为。购买和任务问题可通过联系页面提交工单。
